title: 第五章 扫地出门第六章 学女娲灭个世呢
content_zh:
霜华仙尊对这个孩子的记忆探索一下，嗯嗯，就是希望，外观小小的，内部宽敞，洗手间、厨房，都需要备上。
霜华仙尊能说啥，直接表示同意，并且房车设计叫子沫自己搞定，子沫直接分出，浴室、厕所、厨房、药房、客厅、卧室、电脑房。家具包括双人床、电脑、手机、音响，想想，她还坏心眼的要了一个训练室，里面包括健身器材，那也是都有的。
霜华仙尊就表示了足够的无语，不过这些东西到都不是什么不好弄的，很快就都弄好，房子是京城一套，港岛一套。只是真就是一套，一间60平米的单身公寓而已。看看自己的情况：
姓名：韩紫枫。性别：女。
体质：40（炼气期100）。
力量：40（炼气期100）。
速度：30（炼气期100）。
韧性：40（炼气期100）。
智力：45（炼气期100）。
魅力：100。
悟性：100。
气运：100。
武功：太极拳、太极剑、梯云纵、北冥神功、长春功。
技能：黑客技术、中医大全
装备：炼妖壶
潜能：0。
携带物品：特效安眠药一瓶，京城公寓一间，香港公寓一间。
抽奖劵：0。
体验点：185。
灵石：183颗

感觉咸鱼这边的事情都安排完事儿，紫枫本想说那就继续抽吧，可眼前突然出现一个人，额，认识，是自家大伯母。疑惑的看着大伯母，她无奈的对仙尊说：“等等，休息几天，我先把这里的事情处理一下。”
说完，她这才问：“大伯母，什么事情？”
对付很嫌弃的说：“呸，谁是你大伯母，你也配，你简直是丢了所有韩家人的脸。”
紫枫一脸的疑惑，什么鬼？大伯母真知道，自己在做啥？她想想说：“我要见家主。”
大伯母王琳琅一脸嫌弃的说：“见家主，你也配，滚出去。”
content_en:
Shuanghua Immortal Master explored the memory of this child. Well, I just hope that it is small on the outside but spacious on the inside. The bathroom and kitchen need to be prepared.
What could Shuanghua Immortal say, he directly agreed, and asked Zimo to design the RV himself, and Zimo directly divided out the bathroom, toilet, kitchen, pharmacy, living room, bedroom, and computer room. The furniture includes a double bed, computer, mobile phone, and stereo. Come to think of it, she even asked for a training room with bad intentions, including fitness equipment, which is also available.
Shuanghua Immortal was speechless, but these things were not difficult to get, and they were all done quickly. One house is in Beijing and one in Hong Kong Island. It's just a single apartment of 60 square meters. Take a look at your own situation:
Name: Han Zifeng. Gender: Female.
Constitution: 40 (Qi refining period: 100).
Strength: 40 (100 during Qi refining period).

Raffle ticket: 0.

Spiritual stones: 183
Feeling that everything on Xianyu's side was settled, Zifeng wanted to say just keep smoking, but suddenly a person appeared in front of her. Well, I recognized her, it was her eldest aunt. Looking at the eldest aunt in confusion, she said helplessly to the Immortal Lord: "Wait, take a few days' rest, and let me deal with the things here first."
After saying that, she asked: "Auntie, what's going on?"
Du Fu said with disgust: "Bah, whoever is your eldest aunt is worthy of you. You have simply disgraced the entire Han family."
Zifeng looked confused, what the hell? Auntie really knows what she is doing? She thought about it and said, "I want to see the head of the family."
The eldest aunt Wang Linlang said with a look of disgust: "You are worthy of meeting the master of the house, get out."
